fact: Tata Consultancy Services announced a three-year contract from the Zambia Revenue Authority for an integrated multi-tax system (TaxOnline) with a 24/7 taxpayer portal for e-services, covering VAT, income tax, PAYE and others.
ZRA's TaxOnline went live on 28 October 2013 with online registration and returns, replacing paper and manual administration, per the Global Delivery Initiative case study.
Taxes could be paid electronically through banks linked to TaxOnline from August 2014, with most commercial banks partnered by December 2014; around 70 percent of payments were electronic by 2019.
In 2017, 1,987,675 returns, 98 percent of the total, were filed electronically, and VAT returns could only be filed electronically.
